items.item_text: Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in the State of California
BLS certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross
ACLS certification from the American Heart Association
PALS certification from the American Heart Association
4 years minimum oncology experience, including administration of chemotherapy, CAR-T cells, immune effector cell therapy, Theranostics and experience with side effect management.
Four (4) years of clinical research experience, particularly with the administration of investigational products.
One (1) year of experience and proficiency with peripheral IV access, IV maintenance, and venipuncture, including obtaining IV access an average of 5–10 times per shift.
Four (4) years of pediatric nursing experience.

Four (4) years of experience caring for patients with a wide variety of diagnoses, treatments, and levels of illness severity, including managing emergency situations, preferably in an Emergency Department.

The Clinical and Translational Science Institute (CTSI) is seeking a dedicated and skilled Clinical Research Nurse to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will provide specialized care for patients enrolled in cutting-edge clinical trials and serve as a key research infusion nurse within the Clinical and Translational Research Center.

You will play an essential part in the administration of investigational therapies, including chemotherapy, gene therapy, first-in-human agents, and other novel therapeutics, while ensuring the highest standards of safety, precision, and patient support. This position offers a dynamic and varied practice environment, with opportunities to provide research-related care across UCLA Health clinics, inpatient units, and community-based settings.

Working under the guidance of the Unit Director, you will deliver exceptional direct patient care, collaborate with study teams to optimize protocol-specific workflows, and help advance promising innovations from bench to bedside. You’ll also apply strong leadership, communication, and teaching skills as you educate patients and staff, support operational excellence, and uphold professional standards across all aspects of research nursing.
Willingness to adapt to changing workload requirements, including flexibility in work location as needed to support the unit's mission to investigators and research participants

Demonstrates responsibility for effect on others by respecting others' opinions and ideas, maintaining cooperative and collaborative relationships with co-workers, demonstrating professional control in stressful situations, and readily assisting co-workers while maintaining interdepartmental communication
Ability to follow and manage complex research protocols, document accurately and in a timely fashion, and report protocol deviations; role requires working PM shifts, holidays, and weekends as needed
Ability to complete a nursing physical assessment
Demonstrated ability to assess patients, synthesize and analyze data, and make decisions to ensure patient safety in a research environment
Ability to perform with limited supervision amid frequent changes in priorities and deadlines, and to delegate tasks in a management style consistent with promoting leadership and teamwork
Knowledge base or willingness to learn new information to educate patients, families, and staff on clinical research and patient care issues

Ability to read a clinical trial protocol, meet with the principal investigator and study team, synthesize a written protocol summary, and work with the team to create a plan to open the study in the CTRC
Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively determine priorities
Interpersonal skills to communicate positively and effectively with patients, colleagues, and people from diverse cultures and backgrounds
Ability to work in different areas of the Health System and in the community, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed for operational needs

Ability to use computer systems to manage documentation and patient care through the EMR, use internal databases to retrieve information, and send emails, calendar invites, and create teaching documents
Ability to complete required competencies throughout the year to maintain up-to-date skills and knowledge in rapidly changing patient care and clinical research situations
